svg.title: Haunts theme picker
svg.desc: Settings, Appearance: three theme cards with live previews, light and dark, and a single-column layout at the largest text size.
svg.text: Live previews render each real theme on sample content (never the user's own headline: HEAD-13). One tap applies; no confirmation; nothing locked, promoted or marked NEW.

svg.text: Screen reader: the three themes are one radio group. Each is a single element, e.g.
"Warm. Cream and plum, with serif headlines. Selected. 1 of 3." Previews are hidden from assistive
technology (the name and description carry the meaning). Selection is shown by a thick border and a
check mark, never colour alone (A11Y-2). Every target ≥ 44 pt (A11Y-5). Switching cross-fades in
200 ms, or instantly under Reduce Motion. The choice persists and survives export and restore (THEME-5).
